items.quote: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,
items.claim: The text says the instructions that follow were spoken by the LORD to Moses. This records what the text says about where the law came from. It is not a verified historical event.
items.mechanism: divine speech passed on to Moses

items.quote: Speak unto the children of Israel, and say unto them, When a man shall make a singular vow, the persons shall be for the LORD by thy estimation.
items.claim: Moses is told to give the Israelites a rule: when a man makes a special vow, the people covered by it belong to the LORD at a value set by an assessment.
items.actor: Moses (instructed to speak to the children of Israel)
items.mechanism: people dedicated by a vow are valued by an assessment ("by thy estimation")
